title: Merged auxiliary exteriors: conditional κ = 5.5354656014473e-5
body:
## Conditional improvement

$$T(n)=O\big(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}\big),\qquad \kappa=\frac{55354656014473}{10^{18}}=5.5354656014473\times10^{-5}.$$

That is **+6.97% over #79**, which this builds on (head 79dd6e1), and **+4.86% over #95**, the best open PR when this was opened. The bit saving is `27678860161103/500000000000000000`. All inherited all-size and analytic hypotheses remain assumptions.

## Change

Every auxiliary role pays a separate exterior edge `I − I_h⊗B` (profile `[h, m−2h]`). Auxiliary source frames are free, so each role can merge that residual into one of its endpoint edges:

- **creation edge** `I − (I_h − A_first)⊗B`: source and sink shifted by `−E`;
- **retirement edge** `I − A_last⊗B`: non-output roles only.

The choice is made per role. #79's words, gates, XORs, W and deficit are unchanged.

**Frame validity.** No gate, XOR, frame raise or schedule changes. Only auxiliary source and sink frames move; these are free in the upstream contract, and PR29's stage two already uses source `D_0`. A retirement-merged role's final segment, from its last gate frame to the sink, is charged as the single residual it already was. The inherited accounting had split that segment into a cleanup with no gate event plus the exterior.

Every gate incidence, including the center scatter after the middle mixer, therefore keeps #79's frames. #79's replay covers them: dirty basis in both orientations, and frame raises rebuilt from literal XORs. The only new matrices are the merged endpoint residuals, which are idempotent and certified exactly.

| | h23 | h25 |
|---|---:|---:|
| roles | 27,297 | 35,684 |
| merged at creation | 15,410 | 20,111 |
| merged at retirement | 4,216 | 5,149 |
| distinct merged edges certified | 8,537 | 10,601 |

**Corner-rank lemma.** For `M = I − UWᵀ` with `WᵀU = I`, the NE corner rank is:

- `(i−j+1) − r + rank U_{<j} + rank W_{>i}` for `j ≤ i+1`;
- `rank U_{≤i}W_{≥j}ᵀ` above the band.

In the PR34 fixed basis this reduces to ranks of local submatrices `X[S,T]`, so the result does not depend on the line. Each such submatrix is a 0/1 diagonal plus a rank ≤2 correction. Its rank is computed exactly over Q using 2×2 integer determinants, with no modular step.

**Bridge.** Merged edges create bit children up to **552**, above 529. The bit halving degree goes from 9 to **17**, the row coefficient becomes 1059, and the product row stock goes from `p^2000` to **`p^2200`** (gap 991/25). This affects only the row-product slack and the eventual cutoffs, not κ. The inherited `validate_bridge` recomputes all of these.

Proof and scope are in `research/merged-exterior/PROOF.md`.

## Verification

`make merged-exterior-verify` takes about 4 minutes on 4 cores. It does the following:

- Checks the controlled permutations against the pinned PR34 module.
- Recomputes all 56,303 candidate edge profiles exactly and replays the per-role selection.
- Profiles the removed transitions with the unchanged inherited profiler.
- Rebuilds the full child list on top of #79's verified profile.
- Checks the exact and independent moment enclosures, and that the next grid point is rejected.
- Checks the 47 constraints and 7 margins.

There is also a new CI group, `merged`.

The joint-dual, split-pair and balanced-split source manifests pin `Makefile`, `README.md` and the workflow file, so they are re-pinned. The only change to their certificates is the recorded manifest hash.

A full `make verify` passed on Linux (EC2) with a clean `git diff`.

As a discovery-time cross-check, all 19,138 selected edges were compared with direct NE elimination of the full 575×575 physical matrix (one line, mod 2^31−1): 0 mismatches.
